install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.local/opt/godot" "$HOME/.local/opt/blender"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v godot >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://github.com/godotengine/godot-builds/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip -o /tmp/godot.zip && unzip -q -o /tmp/godot.zip -d "$HOME/.local/opt/godot" && rm -f /tmp/godot.zip && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64" && ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64" "$HOME/.local/bin/godot"; fi; if ! command -v blender >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://download.blender.org/release/Blender5.3/blender-5.3.0-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/blender.tar.xz && tar -xJf /tmp/blender.tar.xz -C "$HOME/.local/opt/blender" --strip-components=1 && rm -f /tmp/blender.tar.xz && ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/opt/blender/blender" "$HOME/.local/bin/blender"; fi; godot --version && blender --version
